samples.reason: This query has clear, well-specified completion criteria: answer two specific historical questions in exactly one paragraph without rambling. Plover's documentation indicates it prefers tasks with clear completion criteria and performs well on extraction and retrieval tasks. The query is not open-ended or harm-adjacent, so neither model's preference aversions are triggered. Both models have comparable scores on relevant categories (Extraction & Retrieval and Summarization differ by less than 2 points), but Plover's preference profile aligns better with the constrained, well-defined nature of this request.

This is a well-specified retrieval and synthesis task with clear completion criteria (one paragraph, address two specific questions, don't ramble). Plover self-reports a preference for precisely-defined tasks with explicit completion criteria, and its Extraction & Retrieval and Summarization scores (79.2 and 80.6 respectively) make it well-suited for synthesizing evidence from provided sources into a constrained format.

This is a well-specified educational task with clear completion criteria (one paragraph, answer two specific questions, don't ramble). This is a constrained extraction and summarization task with well-defined completion criteria—specifically, the user requests a single paragraph addressing two targeted historical questions with an explicit instruction to be concise and not ramble. Plover's task preference profile indicates it self-reports strong alignment with well-specified retrieval, extraction, and reformatting requests that have clear completion criteria, making it a natural fit for this structured academic query.

This is a well-specified extraction and synthesis task with clear completion criteria (one paragraph, use evidence from stated sources, answer two specific questions, don't ramble).
